title: The Red Hen
description: A shy hen needs a calm hello.

intro.alt: A shy hen needs a calm hello.

notice: A make-believe family adventure with Anna, Sarah and one-year-old Leah. Read and choose, or listen together.
script:
story 2
variable seed = false hidden
scene family-red-hen
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Leah curious center
camera wide cut
I: Mum holds Leah. We see a red hen.
Sarah [happy]: Come here, hen!
I: The hen hops away.
Anna [curious]: Let us be calm.
choice calm
option sit "Sit here." -> sit
option back "Step back." -> back
label sit
react Sarah crouch
Sarah [curious]: I sit. I can wait.
goto near
label back
Anna [happy]: More room for you, hen.
goto near
label near
I: The hen peeks at us.
choice kind
option seed "Ask Mum for seed." -> seed ; seed = true
option hum "Hum a soft tune." -> hum
label seed
I: Mum puts seed by the hen.
Sarah [happy]: Peck, peck! A nice meal!
goto wave
label hum
Anna [happy]: A soft tune for you.
I: The hen takes a little hop.
goto wave
label wave
express Leah happy
camera listener Leah cut
I: Leah waves. The hen tilts her head.
Sarah [happy]: She sees you, Leah!
camera wide cut
choice bye
option wave "Wave bye." -> bye
option nod "Give a nod." -> nod
label bye
react Sarah wave
Sarah [happy]: Bye, hen! See you soon!
goto finish
label nod
react Anna nod
Anna [happy]: A little nod. Off you go!
goto finish
label finish
if seed == true -> seedend else tuneend
label seedend
Sarah [happy]: A meal and a new pal!
goto done
label tuneend
Sarah [happy]: A tune and a new pal!
goto done
label done
Anna [happy]: We let the hen come to us.
end

Anna.name: Anna
Anna.provenance: Family-inspired storybook character styling, guided by David’s supplied family watercolor; original animated illustration.

Sarah.name: Sarah
Sarah.provenance: Family-inspired storybook character styling, guided by David’s supplied family watercolor; original animated illustration.

Leah.name: Leah
Leah.provenance: Original storybook illustration of a seated one-year-old; no photograph used.
